title: The oriented segment [[a, b]] is an IM 1-current with boundary δ_b − δ_a
statement: Assume (MR). (MR) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: M_W(X) = R.measure(W) whenever R is an IMRep representing X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, W open. For every P ∈ ℕ and a, b ∈ ℝ^P there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) such that ∂S(g) = g(b)⟨⟩ − g(a)⟨⟩ for every test 0-form g on ℝ^P, where g(x)⟨⟩ denotes the value of the 0-covector g(x) on the empty tuple (fun i => i.elim0), M(S) = M_{ℝ^P}(S) < ∞, and spt S ⊆ [a, b] (the closed segment segment ℝ a b).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (a b : Euclid P), ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ g : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0, S.boundary g = (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) b (fun i => i.elim0) - (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) a (fun i => i.elim0)) ∧ S.mass < ∞ ∧ S.support ⊆ segment ℝ a b
